blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A train accident claimed the life of an Indian national in San Pablo City, Laguna, on Tuesday morning, after he was struck by a Philippine National Railways (PNR) train, the Calabarzon police reported. The victim was a 20-year-old businessman who was a motorcycle backrider.
